notices.title: Adjusted Operating Hours and Special Iftar Platter
notices.summary: Crown Coffee will observe modified opening hours during Ramadan. Join us for curated artisanal coffee and fresh savory platters.
notices.content:
Dear Valued Guests,

In observance of the holy month of Ramadan, Crown Coffee Bangladesh will operate under updated daily schedules. Our doors will be open from 3:00 PM until 1:00 AM daily.

We are delighted to introduce our Signature Iftar Platter, pairing roasted specialty espresso beverages with gourmet dates, house-made pastries, and savory delights.

For reservations or advance table bookings, please contact our team directly.

notices.title: New Arrival: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Single Origin Beans
notices.summary: Experience vibrant floral aromas and subtle citrus undertones in our latest micro-lot single origin release.
notices.content:
We are excited to present our newest micro-lot roast: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Grade 1. Hand-picked at high altitudes and light-medium roasted in-house to highlight elegant notes of jasmine, bergamot, and wild honey.

Available now for pour-over brewing, espresso extractions, and whole bean retail bags at our counter.

notices.title: Weekend Barista Masterclass and Latte Art Workshop
notices.summary: Join our lead baristas for an intimate hands-on session exploring espresso extraction techniques and milk texturing.
notices.content:
Crown Coffee is hosting a weekend masterclass designed for coffee enthusiasts and home baristas.

What you will learn:
- Dialing in espresso parameters and extraction ratios
- Micro-foaming technique and pour mechanics for latte art
- Cupping and sensory evaluation of high-score specialty beans

Limited to 8 participants per session. Advance registration is required.
